title: CmdPal: Qualify fallback identity and ranking by provider

proposed_comments.title: Use the existing provider-settings property

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream compilation reports CS0103 at this expression; the constructor assigns the existing ProviderSettings property.

proposed_comments.body:
### Use the existing provider-settings property

**Severity:** `high`

`_providerSettings` is no longer declared on `TopLevelViewModel`, so the new lookup fails compilation with CS0103. The constructor already stores the provider snapshot in the `ProviderSettings` property; use that property when the current settings dictionary has no provider entry.

```suggestion
            : ProviderSettings;
```

proposed_comments.title: Keep disabled fallbacks out of global results

confidence.rationale: The old global-selection helper requires both flags. The added four-case regression fails only for disabled/global=true with the original predicate and all twelve focused cases pass after this edit.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep disabled fallbacks out of global results

**Severity:** `medium`

A fallback can retain `IncludeInGlobalResults = true` while `IsEnabled = false`. The previous `GetGlobalFallbacks()` required both flags, but this predicate checks only global inclusion, and `MainListPage` adds such items to its global sources before the enabled check. The update guard prevents new handler calls but does not exclude a nonempty title from rendering; preserve the enabled condition in the provider-qualified lookup.

```suggestion
    internal bool IncludeInGlobalResults => GetFallbackSettings() is { IsEnabled: true, IncludeInGlobalResults: true };
```
